issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: NudgeForMe
products.tagline: AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities
products.summaryZh: 错失邮件机会的AI跟进代理
products.descriptionZh: NudgeForMe会扫描你已发送的对话，找出其中无人回复的线程，并在你的邮箱内直接起草自然的跟进内容。它从草稿模式开始，让你始终掌控全局。你可以审阅每个机会，挑选有用的，并通过Gmail、Outlook或IMAP/SMTP发送。由Snoooz团队在处理数百万封邮件后打造，NudgeForMe专注于一个令人头疼的工作流程：确保线索、交易、合作伙伴关系及客户对话不会悄然冷却。
products.description: NudgeForMe scans your sent conversations, finds threads where someone never replied, and drafts natural follow-ups inside your own mailbox. It starts in draft mode, so you stay in control. You can review each opportunity, select the useful ones, and send from Gmail, Outlook, or IMAP/SMTP. Built by the Snoooz team after processing millions of emails, NudgeForMe is focused on one painful workflow: making sure leads, deals, partnerships, and customer conversations do not quietly go cold.

products.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
products.tagline: Frontier agent intelligence at Flash prices
products.summaryZh: 前沿智能体，闪电价格
products.descriptionZh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731是V4-Flash的官方版本，在智能体能力上实现了巨大飞跃。它在关键基准测试中优于V4-Pro（预览版），原生支持Responses API，并已全面适配Codex CLI。
products.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the official release of V4-Flash, featuring a massive leap in agentic capabilities. It outperforms V4-Pro (Preview) on key benchmarks, natively supports the Responses API, and is fully adapted for Codex CLI.

products.name: Port22
products.tagline: Claude Code, Codex & more on your phone
products.summaryZh: Claude Code、Codex 等，尽在您的手机
products.descriptionZh: 我会启动一个长时间的代理运行，然后走开，回来时发现它花了20分钟等我批准一次文件编辑。Port22将你Mac上运行的所有编码代理都带到手机上。查看哪些在正常工作，哪些卡住了。当某个代理需要权限时，你的手机会震动，你点击它实际提供的选项，而不是猜测的按键。它附着在你已有的运行环境上。无需包装器，无需配置，无需新终端。一台Mac和两个会话免费，所有功能开启。
products.description: I'd start a long agent run, walk away, and come back to find it had spent 20 minutes waiting on me to approve one file edit. Port22 puts every coding agent running on your Mac onto your phone. See which are working and which are stuck. When one needs permission your phone buzzes and you tap the actual option it offered, not a guessed keystroke. It attaches to what you already run. No wrapper, no config, no new terminal. Free for one Mac and two sessions, every feature on.

products.name: AgentMicro
products.tagline: Live Codex task status in your macOS menu bar
products.summaryZh: macOS菜单栏中的实时Codex任务状态
products.descriptionZh: AgentMicro 是一款本地优先的 macOS 菜单栏助手，用于监督并行的 Codex Desktop 和 CLI 任务。它一目了然地显示任务状态、项目、耗时和结果，并可通过一次点击打开对应的 Codex Desktop 任务。它仅观察本地元数据，绝不上传提示、响应、源代码或任务历史。
products.description: AgentMicro is a local-first macOS menu-bar companion for supervising parallel Codex Desktop and CLI tasks. It surfaces task state, project, elapsed time, and results at a glance, then opens the matching Codex Desktop task with one click. It observes local metadata only and never uploads prompts, responses, source code, or task history.

products.name: Yamanote 3D
products.tagline: Ride Tokyo’s Yamanote Line in a 3D world
products.summaryZh: 在3D世界中乘坐东京山手线
products.descriptionZh: 山手线3D是一款受东京山手线启发的免费浏览器体验。漫步于E235车厢内，坐下，眺望城市，聆听播报，到站下车。我制作它是为了在学习或工作时，能有逼真的列车声和城市氛围作为背景。非常欢迎反馈。
products.description: Yamanote 3D is a free browser experience inspired by Tokyo’s Yamanote Line. Walk through an E235 carriage, sit down, watch the city, listen to announcements, and get off at stations. I built it to have realistic train sounds and city ambience in the background while studying or working. Feedback is very welcome.

products.name: TerminalWidget
products.tagline: Put script output in your Desktop/Home screen widgets.
products.summaryZh: 将脚本输出放到桌面/主屏幕小组件中。
products.descriptionZh: 在macOS、iOS和iPadOS上，通过可自定义的小组件展示命令输出、进度、迷你趋势图及图像。通用应用，一次购买即可。
products.description: Display command output, progress, sparklines, and images in customizable widgets for macOS, iOS, and iPadOS. Universal app, one-time purchase.

products.name: Terminal Candy
products.tagline: A native macOS terminal you can skin and theme
products.summaryZh: 一款可自定义外观和主题的原生macOS终端
products.descriptionZh: Terminal Candy 是一个真实、原生的 macOS 终端，你可以直接生活在其中。选择一款皮肤——Game Boy、卡带机、Pip-Boy，或者你自己的创作——然后在上面直接绘制终端方块。当 Claude Code 或 Codex 真正需要输入时，它会通过声音和 Dock 弹跳提醒你，让你不再需要时刻盯着窗口。Skin Builder 可将任意图像转化为终端；提供 84 种调色板、CRT 效果、⌥Space 快捷键以及社区皮肤市场。14 天免费试用，之后一次性支付 10 美元，无订阅。支持 macOS 14+，Apple Silicon。
products.description: Terminal Candy is a real, native macOS terminal you live inside. Pick a skin — Game Boy, cassette deck, Pip-Boy, or your own art — and draw the terminal square right on it. It pings you (sound + dock bounce) when Claude Code or Codex actually needs input, so you stop babysitting the window. The Skin Builder turns any image into a terminal; 84 palettes, CRT effects, ⌥Space hotkey, community skin marketplace. 14-day free trial, then $10 once — no subscription. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

products.name: Basedash Audit Logs
products.tagline: Every action in your BI tool, on the record.
products.summaryZh: 您的BI工具中的每一个操作，均有记录。
products.descriptionZh: Basedash 原生审计日志——每一次登录、查询和配置变更均有记录，包括 AI 执行的每一次查询，均可归属和追溯。通过一个筛选器回答谁在何时看到了什么，将事件流式传输至 SIEM，按策略设置保留期限，并通过 API 拉取日志。专为安全审查和企业部署而构建，同时支持 SSO、SCIM 和 RBAC。您的 BI 工具终于有了记忆。每一次操作，皆有记录。
products.description: Native audit logs for Basedash — every sign-in, query, and configuration change is on the record, including every query the AI runs, attributed and traceable. Answer who saw what, when with one filter, stream events to your SIEM, set retention to match your policy, and pull the log through the API. Built for security reviews and enterprise rollouts, alongside SSO, SCIM, and RBAC. Your BI tool finally has a memory. Every action, on the record.

products.name: SyncStaq
products.tagline: Stripe billing data, always current in Google Sheets
products.summaryZh: Stripe账单数据，在Google Sheets中始终保持最新
products.descriptionZh: SyncStaq将Stripe账单数据同步至Google Sheets——包括费用、发票、发票行项目、客户、订阅、付款和争议，每项数据分别存放在结构化的标签页中。不同之处在于：大多数导出和脚本按创建日期拉取数据，因此后续变更的记录（退款、订阅更新、争议）会悄然过期。SyncStaq从Stripe的事件流同步，因此当数据变化时，您的表格会随之更新。只读Stripe访问权限。每小时同步。14天免费试用。
products.description: SyncStaq syncs Stripe billing data into Google Sheets — charges, invoices, invoice line items, customers, subscriptions, payouts and disputes, each in its own structured tab. What's different: most exports and scripts pull by created date, so records that change later (refunds, subscription updates, disputes) quietly go stale. SyncStaq syncs from Stripe's event stream, so your sheet updates when the data changes. Read-only Stripe access. Hourly sync. 14-day free trial.

products.name: unquestion
products.tagline: The form that asks like a person
products.summaryZh: 像人一样提问的表格
products.descriptionZh: 静态表单常被弃之不理。Unquestion改用AI对话：它能灵活应变，通过追问深入挖掘，引导用户坚持答完。你获得的是表格中干净、结构化的数据，而非冗长的对话记录。
products.description: Static forms get abandoned. Unquestion runs an AI conversation instead: it adapts, digs deeper with follow-ups, and keeps people answering to the end. You get clean, structured data in tables, not transcripts.

products.name: Quillly
products.tagline: Publish straight from your AI. No dashboard detour.
products.summaryZh: 直接从AI发布，无需经过仪表盘。
products.descriptionZh: Quillly可将任何AI助手（Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor）转化为完整的发布团队。只需连接一次域名，你的AI即可创建SEO评分的博客、文档和更新日志，在数秒内实时发布，提交至7个搜索引擎，并跟踪排名、收录和流量——全部在一个仪表盘中完成。
products.description: Quillly turns any AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) into a full publishing team. Connect your domain once, then your AI creates SEO-scored blogs, docs and changelogs, publishes them live in seconds, submits them to 7 search engines, and tracks rankings, indexing and traffic - all from one dashboard.

products.name: Tokimeter
products.tagline: Local usage analytics for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Grok & More
products.summaryZh: Claude、Codex、Cursor、Grok 等工具的本地使用分析
products.descriptionZh: Tokimeter 将你的 AI 编码工具已写入的使用记录汇总为一份报告。按项目、会话、日期、工具和模型统计成本及精确 token 数量。支持 5 小时和每周限额窗口，并在状态栏中显示预算警告。覆盖 Claude 和 Codex 的 CLI 及桌面应用，以及 Cursor、Grok Build、Hermes、opencode、Cline 和 Copilot CLI。无需账户，无遥测，数据不离开你的设备。报告：npx tokimeter report 安装：见下文 开源且基于 MIT 许可。
products.description: Tokimeter pulls the usage records your AI coding tools already write into one report. Costs and exact token counts by project, session, day, tool and model. 5-hour and weekly limit windows, with budget warnings in your status line. Covers Claude and Codex in both the CLI and the desktop apps, plus Cursor, Grok Build, Hermes, opencode, Cline and Copilot CLI. No account, no telemetry, nothing leaves your machine. Report: npx tokimeter report Install: Check Below Open source & MIT licensed.

products.name: Monolite
products.tagline: Turn any audience into active participants
products.summaryZh: 让任何受众都成为积极参与者
products.descriptionZh: Monolite助您创建互动游戏。即时二维码加入或公开参与、自定义品牌标识及详细报告。立即免费试用Monolite！
products.description: Monolite helps you to create interactive games. Instant QR join or public participation, custom branding, and detailed reports. Try Monolite free today!

products.name: ViiTor Translate
products.tagline: Real-time subtitles that keep up with speech and context
products.summaryZh: 实时字幕，紧跟语音与语境。
products.descriptionZh: ViiTor为iOS、Android和Chrome上的直播、视频、会议和课程提供实时翻译字幕。专为快速且语境丰富的音频设计，它能捕捉直译常遗漏的俚语、文化引用和内部梗。在YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili及其他支持的平台上使用悬浮字幕，无需切换屏幕。适合K-pop、Vtuber、动漫等内容。支持20多种语言，可免费试用。
products.description: ViiTor brings real-time translated subtitles to livestreams, videos, meetings and classes on iOS, Android and Chrome. Built for fast, context-heavy audio, it captures slang, cultural references and inside jokes that literal translation often misses. Use Floating Subtitles on YouTube, TikTok, Bilibili and other supported platforms without switching screens. Ideal for K-pop, Vtubers, anime and more. Supports 20+ languages and is free to try.

products.name: Curate
products.tagline: Track films, books and TV, all in one place.
products.summaryZh: 在一个地方追踪电影、书籍和电视节目。
products.descriptionZh: 记录你所观看和阅读的一切。通过真实的人类品味发现电影、书籍和电视节目。无广告。没有算法决定你应该喜欢什么。只是一个为认真对待观看和阅读内容的人精心打造的空间。
products.description: Track everything you watch and read. Discover movies, books and TV through real human taste. No ads. No algorithms deciding what you should like. Just a thoughtfully built space for people who take what they watch and read seriously.

products.name: Omnitopical
products.tagline: Turn Your Website Into an Industry Authority
products.summaryZh: 将您的网站打造成行业权威
products.descriptionZh: 一个域名，无限页面。全面覆盖主题。我们负责地图绘制、内容撰写、链接构建及发布，助您提升排名所需的一切。每月99美元。
products.description: One domain. Unlimited pages. Full topical coverage. We map, write, link, and publish everything you need to rank. $99/mo.

products.name: EssayKraft
products.tagline: Native essay writing app for Mac and iPad
products.summaryZh: Mac和iPad原生写作应用
products.descriptionZh: EssayKraft是一款原生Swift编写的Mac和iPad写作应用，专为厌倦与文献管理工具纠缠的学生打造。它内置文献管理器、自动引文、富文本格式以及PDF或DOCX导出功能，让你在一个地方完成论文、报告和学位论文的写作。无需订阅，无需账户，也无需在多个引文工具间切换。只需一个快速、无干扰的写作体验，专为学术工作设计。一次购买，永久拥有。
products.description: EssayKraft is a native Swift Mac and iPad writing app built for students who are tired of wrestling with reference managers. Write essays, papers and dissertations with a built-in reference manager, automatic citations, rich text formatting and PDF or DOCX export, all in one place. No subscriptions, no accounts, no juggling citation tools. Just a fast, distraction-free writing experience designed specifically for academic work. Buy once, own it forever.

products.name: Kopai
products.tagline: Share your expertise, and let our agents earn for you.
products.summaryZh: 分享你的专业知识，让我们的代理为你赚取收益。
products.descriptionZh: Kopai将你的专业知识转化为可销售的AI代理，按消息计费而非按小时计费。上传你的知识，无需编码即可在几分钟内发布，让人们为即时答案付费，而不是预约你的日程。你的代理所赚取的收入，你保留70%。内置评估测试、加密知识库和多代理编排，意味着这不是一个提示词包装器，而是真正的基础设施。我们处理发现、计费和信任问题，让你专注于自己擅长的领域。
products.description: Kopai turns your expertise into an AI agent you can sell, priced per message instead of per hour. Upload your knowledge, publish in minutes with no code, and let people pay for instant answers instead of booking your calendar. You keep 70% of everything your agent earns. Built-in evaluation testing, encrypted knowledge bases, and multi-agent orchestration mean it's not a prompt wrapper, it's real infrastructure. We handle discovery, billing, and trust so you can focus on what you know.

products.name: Tandem
products.tagline: AI-native office leasing brokerage
products.summaryZh: AI原生的办公租赁经纪服务
products.descriptionZh: Tandem正在构建一个AI原生的办公室租赁经纪平台。每位Tandem经纪人都配备了一个智能代理大脑。它持续监控市场动态：今早新出的房源、上月类似单元的实际成交价、哪些房东在租期上灵活、哪些物业即将重新上市。掌握市场信息不再是一个人的工作，因此不会因他们下班而中断，也不局限于他们亲自考察过的楼宇。
products.description: Tandem is building an AI-native office leasing brokerage. Every Tandem agent works with an agentic brain behind them. It's watching the market constantly: what came available this morning, what a similar unit actually leased for last month, which landlords are flexible on term, what's about to come back online. Knowing the market stops being one person's job, so it doesn't stop when they go home, and it isn't limited to the buildings they've personally walked.

products.name: Pokey
products.tagline: Make your screen shares unmissable
products.summaryZh: 让你的屏幕分享不容错过
products.descriptionZh: ✦ 为重复的团队同步和站会增添一丝趣味 ✦ 在销售电话和初次会议中打破僵局 ✦ 缓和审查错误或艰难反馈时的紧张气氛 ✦ Pokey——一款小巧的菜单栏应用，让你的光标成为他们记住你通话的理由。因为没有人应该再忍受一次无聊的屏幕共享 😀
products.description: ✦ Add a spark of fun to repetitive team syncs and standups ✦ Break the ice on sales calls and intro meetings ✦ Soften tense moments when reviewing errors or tough feedback ✦ Pokey – a tiny menu bar app that turns your cursor into the reason they remember your call. Because nobody should suffer through another boring screen share 😀
